data.name: Scoop 'n Shoot
data.detailed_description:
For centuries, the dark mage Kirusza has lusted after the magical crystals. His goal: unimaginable power. But the wise wizard Skovhir hid the crystals in the last place Kirusza would look: an unsuspecting ice cream parlor.

Following Skovhir's death, the fate of the world now rests in your hands. As his apprentice, you have been chosen to continue both the business and the battle. Are you ready to serve up magical scoops and put a stop to Kirusza?

Magical Ice Cream Factory

Grow and harvest mystical plants to create powerful ice cream flavors. Each flavor unleashes destructive elemental forces effective against different types of enemies.

Defend the Shop

Kirusza has dispatched his minions, the Semacios, to destroy your business. Use your magical ice and your weapon to fight them off before they can reach the crystals.

About the Project

Scoop 'n Shoot is a passion project developed by our 5-person student team over the course of 1.5 years. We are proud to finally share the results of our hard work with you!

A Note on Development:
Since this is a completed student project, we cannot promise regular content updates or expansions. However, we hope you have as much fun playing it as we did making it. Feedback and reviews are always welcome and help us on our future paths as game developers!

data.short_description: Scoop 'n Shoot mixes gardening with frantic VR shooting action. Harvest extraordinary plants to create magical ice cream flavors, each with unique powers. Use your creations to blast away the evil magician Kirusza and his minions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 970 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR: Roomfilling VR, 2x2m Play Area
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790 or equivalent
  • Graphics: GTX 980 or higher
  • VR Support: OpenXR: Valve Index HMD, Valve Index Controller, 4x4m Play Area

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04 LTS / SteamOS via Proton
  • Processor: i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 970 or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR: Roomfilling VR, 2x2m Play Area
  • Additional Notes: ! ! ! Important ! ! ! While we can confirm that the game will run using steams proton layer, we cannot confirm it's working with VR. Unity's OpenXR plugin currently does not allow a native linux build.
